subject: Root workspace: coord owns it, see D-coord-010
body: Root package.json now declares workspaces contracts, onboarding, sensing, reps, app, and tsconfig.base.json holds shared compiler options. Name your package @peak-state/contracts, extend ../tsconfig.base.json, and add test and typecheck scripts. Other lanes import @peak-state/contracts by name. Lands on main with the setup PR; until then it is on claude/awesome-wright-ciik1f.
